200.description:
The Bank of Canada policy interest rate (target for the overnight rate, Valet series V39079): the rate in effect today or on any date since 1992, the most recent change and every change in the history window (three years back by default), each with the previous rate and the move in basis points. A decision the series has not yet published (it takes effect the business day after the announcement and reaches the series about a day later) is read from the Bank's press releases and reported as announced_change.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| `as_of` | string |  |
| `attribution` | string | Required attribution under the Bank of Canada terms of use. |
| `changes` | object[] | Rate changes within the history window, newest first, dated the day they took effect (the business day after the announcement); an announced_change in effect is included first. Empty when the rate did not move. |
| `history` | object |  |
| `label` | string |  |
| `last_change` | object | Most recent change within the history window, including an announced_change in effect; null when the rate did not move in it. |
| `note` | string |  |
| `observation_date` | string | Latest business day of series V39079 on or before as_of. When announced_change is in effect, the rate comes from the announcement and this is the last day the series had published. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `rate_percent` | number | Policy rate in percent in effect on as_of: the latest observation on or before it, or the rate set by an announced_change already in effect that the series has not yet published. |
| `series` | string |  |
| `source_url` | string | The Bank of Canada URL that answered (the first page for multi-page scans). |
| `terms_url` | string |  |
| `unit` | string |  |
